name: Request Details 29
definition: Details of the settlement condition modification request.

Reference.name: Reference
Reference.definition: References of the transaction for which the securities settlement condition modification is requested.

RestrictionReference.name: Restriction Reference
RestrictionReference.definition: Restriction references applied on the transaction for which the securities settlement condition modification is requested.

RetainIndicator.name: Retain Indicator
RetainIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the instruction due to expire is confirmed for settlement.

Linkage.name: Linkage
Linkage.definition: Specifies the type of linkage requested.

Priority.name: Priority
Priority.definition: Specifies whether the transaction is to be executed with a high priority.

OtherProcessing.name: Other Processing
OtherProcessing.definition: Specifies another type of processing change request.

PartialSettlementIndicator.name: Partial Settlement Indicator
PartialSettlementIndicator.definition: Specifies whether partial settlement is allowed.

SecuritiesRTGS.name: Securities RTGS
SecuritiesRTGS.definition: Specifies whether the settlement transaction is to be settled through an RTGS or a non RTGS system.

HoldIndicator.name: Hold Indicator
HoldIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the transaction is on hold/blocked/frozen.

MatchingDenial.name: Matching Denial
MatchingDenial.definition: Specifies the matching processing change requested.

UnilateralSplit.name: Unilateral Split
UnilateralSplit.definition: Specifies that the transaction is requested to be unilaterally split.

ModificationRequestPresenceRule.definition: At least one securities settlement conditions modification request type must be present.

OtherProcessingRule.definition: If OtherProcessing is used, then its usage must be pre-agreed between the sender and receiver.

SettlementConditionModificationApplicabi.definition: All settlement condition modification request types do not apply to all account servicers.
